programme.desc: Pan Yi Ming must attend his father's funeral to claim the huge inheritance. When he returns home, he reunites with his ex-girlfriend and her family, but ended up falling into their trap.

programme.title: Bullet and Brain
programme.desc: Bullet and Brain now return for a mission - to protect the granddaughter of the triad boss. Can they succeed without breaking their vows?

programme.title: All's Well End's Well 97
programme.desc: Mr. Lo's sons prank Kung on his birthday with a fake lottery win, sparking chaos that unexpectedly heals old wounds and brings the quirky family closer together.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. Inspired by the respected Master Wen, Sheng gradually changes his attitude towards his career and life.

programme.title: iGirl
programme.desc: The 1st Asian New Media FF's Best Actress Chrissie Chau reunites with Ekin Cheng in this story of three jilted men, who decide to invest in android girlfriends.

programme.title: High Forces
programme.desc: An A380 airliner is hijacked by gunmen on its maiden flight. Among the passengers is a security expert, whose daughter is one of the captives. Can he save all the passengers and avert the crisis?

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in Shanghai
programme.desc: Revisit the legend of Ma Yong Zhen, a boxer who only wanted to survive in Shanghai, but was swept into a battle against its largest triad on a quest for revenge.

programme.title: Ultimate Malevolence
programme.desc: Featuring three stories about two high school friends, a magician and a lost man, the movie reveals the most terrifying and ugly side of human nature, where life and death are just a thought away!

programme.title: Another Me
programme.desc: One day, Constable Li Mao accidentally discovers that he looks exactly like the prince. Wanting a better life for himself, Li agrees to switch places with the prince, who wants freedom.

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: A sozzled police inspector (Jackie Chan) must pull himself up again after a bungled mission causes his entire team to be wiped out.

programme.title: The Sparring Partner
programme.desc: A top-rated film based on a true case in Hong Kong, it tells of a young man who plots with his friend to murder & dismember his parents, resulting in a highly controversial court case.

programme.title: The Brotherhood of Rebel
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his friend Meow flee after Meow's attempt to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, their paths cross when Meow's life is in danger again. Will Chai choose loyalty over duty?

programme.title: Mission Milano
programme.desc: Andy Lau & Huang Xiao Ming embark on a cross-border quest in the quest to protect an incredible new invention from an international crime conglomerate.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: A prisoner escaped under Master Zhang's custody, causing his expulsion. He sets off to find the prisoner, only to discover that the war between humans & demons have begun!

programme.title: The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: A Hong Kong megastar decides to make a film about rural China to win an award at a film festival. He experiences village life for a farmer's role, but this results in a series of hilarious events.

programme.title: The Prosecutor
programme.desc: A young man is wrongly convicted of drug trafficking. A former cop turned prosecutor believes in his innocence and launches an investigation, risking his life and career to find the true perpetrator.

programme.title: May We Chat
programme.desc: Dealing with the controversial issues of youth and sex, this film captures how three young women struggle to find a balance between reality and their ideals.

programme.title: I Love Hong Kong 2013
programme.desc: Sung Chi Hung and Ha Shek Lam were best friends before they fell in love with the same girl and became rivals. Many years later, Ha becomes a real estate tycoon and is determined to strike back...

programme.title: Love Lies
programme.desc: Gynaecologist Veronica falls for an online dating app scam with young Joe, who poses as a French engineer. What begins as a romance built on lies ultimately transforms two seemingly mismatched souls.

programme.title: Wise Guys Never Die
programme.desc: Nick meets Teddy when he is sent to prison for embezzlement. After their release, they team up with Teddy's lover Lora, to take revenge on Dragon, will Nick finally join Teddy in his revenge?

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Set in 2020 during the outbreak of COVID-19, the movie features interconnected stories of three women's lives as they navigate the uncertain future amongst their respective friends and families.

programme.title: Panda Plan
programme.desc: Legendary kung fu star Jackie Chan adopts a panda names Hu Hu. When a crime syndicate places a bounty on the panda, Jackie, his agent, and Hu Hu's caretaker embark on a quest to outsmart the villains.

programme.title: My Prince Edward
programme.desc: In this 39th Hong Kong Film Award winner, a newly-engaged woman tries to rid herself of a secret sham marriage to a mainlander. Will she be able to free herself from her past?

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired special agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the street is forcibly demolished by the local gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed.

programme.title: Band Four
programme.desc: An aspiring singer reunites with her estranged guitarist father, and along with other family members, they unite to support each other through their love for music.

programme.title: Black Ransom
programme.desc: This action-packed drama as a grieving special force member whose investigation of the triads exposes the involvement of a corrupt cop.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Caught in an underground fight to pay off debts, talented boxer Jia Yang loses her Olympics dream and quits boxing. A decade later, Coach Li aids her comeback. Can Jia Yang resurrect her boxing dream?

programme.title: Crypto Storm
programme.desc: ICAC officer Lok sets up a special team to investigate a corruption case involving a bank's top executive's use of cryptocurrency to manipulate the trading market.

programme.title: The Invisible Guest
programme.desc: Joanna is a suspect of a locked-room murder where her lover is found dead. When the police investigates the case, they discover another murder case which leads them to the truth.

programme.title: Find Your Voice
programme.desc: Renowned conductor Yin Tze Long agrees to lead a pilot program training 3 underperforming school choirs to participate in an inter-school choral competition.

programme.title: My Blue Summer

programme.title: A Legend
programme.desc: An archaeologist uncovers artifacts from a glacier expedition that resembles a jade pendant in his dream, so he leads his team to a fantastical adventure into the glacier to unveil the truth.

programme.title: Far Far Away

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: After a kung-fu master (Lau Kar Leung) is crippled by a ruthless villain, he teaches a boy monkey kung-fu to avenge his shame.

programme.title: The Amorous Lotus Pan
programme.desc: Directed by Chow Sze Loke and Li Han Hsiang, this classic starring Diana Chang, Chang Chung and Pai Yun depicts how Lotus Pan marries a midget, yet has an affair.

programme.title: Lady of the Law
programme.desc: One of director Shen Chiang's last works, this action-packed adventure features a lone female fighter, decades before the dawn of pro-feminist kung fu films.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This comedy contains dramatisations of some of the funniest and most surreal film gossips of director Li Han-Hsiang's 30 year career.

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: In this film, award winning actor Ku Feng stars as the 'Whip Devil' alongside Shih Szu as the 'The Lady Hermit' against the masters of mayhem.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: This moving tale centers on a childless woman who cares for an emotionally battered girl.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Ding, a con woman swindles a diamond ring off a rich man, but when it ends up in another man's hands, she now has to get it back.

programme.title: Legend of the Fox
programme.desc: This exciting tale of revenge features cameos from the director's three most popular 'Venoms,' Kuo Chue, Chiang Sheng and Lu Feng.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: From veteran director Li Han-hsiang comes this fascinating period drama, starring Li Kun as the ingenious Lord Liu, who is much envied by the Emperor.

programme.title: The Emperor and His Brother
programme.desc: This epic depicts how Chen Chia Lo and his men set out to persuade the Qing Emperor Chien Lung to acknowledge his Han bloodline and join the anti-Qing movement.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The film's curious title refers to two props that signal a happy beginning to what develops into a tragic love story, linking a scholar and a local beauty.

programme.title: Heads for Sale
programme.desc: Chiao Chiao stars in the popular tale of a decapitating swordswoman who will let nothing stand in her way when she falls in love with a bandit's son.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: This Inoue Umetsugu musical depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching Ping and Pai Hung.

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by 'Drunken Master', this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist who creates a cricket-style fighting technique to defeat the pugilists who bested him before.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The Mad Monk rushes around saving hawkers from crumbling walls and bullies, recovering stolen money and punishing a ruthless court official and his son.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: This is a thrilling mix of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, vengeance and edge-of-your-seat gambling duels.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Be tickled by the slippery efforts of three pickpockets, so adept at their chosen skill that they even manage to fleece three beauties of their underwear!

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A group of top martial artists try to unveil the truth surrounding a bloody parrot. However, the path ahead is fraught with many challenges.

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A martial artist joins the police force in order to pursue the man who killed his best friend but it is only years later that he discovers a startling clue.

programme.title: The Naval Commandos
programme.desc: Tony Liu, Ti Lung, Fu Sheng, David Chiang and Shih Szu star in this rousing epic of a near suicidal mission to destroy the Japanese Navy's flagship in 1937.

programme.title: Martial Club
programme.desc: Wong Fei Hung (Gordon Liu) fights for balance in the martial world with the evil Lu school and a northern master in their employ.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: Director Anthony Chan joins award-winning social satirist Alfred Cheung Kin Ting in this delightful variation on the hugely successful British Carry On!

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: Share the exploits of two con men vying for a horde of hidden gold. In addition to the mix is a Shaolin monk and his dangerous mute sister!

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: An alluring female fairy seeks love among mortals and finds it in a man who takes care of an orphanage.

programme.title: Pursuit of a Killer
programme.desc: The charm of Pursuit Of A Killer lies in the long awaited reunion of Five Venoms duo, Lo Meng and Sun Chien, in the roles of criminal and cop.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical production features George Lam in a humorous tale of a man who seeks love and success in a world of TV commercials, along with his two friends.

programme.title: Usurpers of Emperor's Power
programme.desc: When Prince Li of the Sung Dynasty is exiled with his lovely wife and faithful warrior, Li Lan, he later commits suicide. Now, it is up to Li Lan to avenge him.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: Families win and lose fortunes overnight while neighbours swindle each other as stock as speculation madness takes over Hong Kong.

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A motorcycle workshop owner feels compelled to damn the physical and legal consequences and go on racing.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: A nightclub owner (Peter Chen Ho) has his way with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Also starring Lily Ho, Chin Ping.

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: This actioner revolves around the conflicts of kung fu masters. Complications further ensue when one of them falls for a princess.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang directs this fascinating comedy about three couples and forbidden love across Macau and Hong Kong.

programme.title: Murderer Pursues
programme.desc: In this fascinating saga about a Sino-Vietnamese crime gang, Danny Lee plays a misunderstood refugee, while Ray Lui is a cop battling his own conscience.

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: The 'Venoms' bid a fond farewell to their internationally beloved film series with this saga about a building that bristles with booby-trapped blades.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: After Ah Niu moves to Hong Kong, a kind-hearted fellow from rural China is taken advantage by cunning characters including his uncle.

programme.title: The Bully
programme.desc: When a restaurant customer turns out to be a kung-fu harbinger of doom, a persecuted waiter turns to a famed 'drunken master' for help.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Sparks fly when a female doctor criticizes a fashion designer's creations, but love follows regardless.

programme.title: The Lady Is the Boss
programme.desc: A martial arts sifu and a hip marketing wiz have to overlook their differences to outsmart gangsters who are trying to take them down.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: An insane swordsman takes to making Chinese lamps from the skin of his enemies' sisters, mistresses and wives!

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: Directed by Chang cheh, this kung fu film is one of the final efforts in the 'Venoms'' genre. It features a main character who is mistaken for a clan leader.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang brings us this delightful adventure, which revolves around Emperor Chien Lung's incognito journey through China.

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: Superstar Cheng Pei-pei stars as Yen Lai, the one woman who can reunite the Kao brothers in a bid to save the Teng Lung Manor and avenge their father's death.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Fans of 'The Little Mermaid' are in for a delightful surprise when they see this spectacular Chinese operatic adaptation, where a carp turns into a fairy.

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: Martial arts greats Lau Kar Leung and Alexander Fu play out the vendetta of General Yang and the creation of the unique eight-diagram pole fight technique.
